data.name: Samrithi
data.gender_notes: Samrithi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Samrithi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Samruthi', which means 'achieving peace and prosperity'. It signifies the attainment of balance, harmony, and calmness in one's life. The name Samrithi carries the meaning “Achieving Peace and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Samrithi usually hope their child will grow to embody achieving peace and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samrithi represents the divine power that grants peace and prosperity to an individual. It is believed that invoking this name brings harmony and balance to one's life, and helps in overcoming challenges and obstacles.
data.etymology: Samrithi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Achieving Peace and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samrithi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In Hindu traditions, the pursuit of inner peace and external prosperity is a fundamental aspect of living a fulfilling and meaningful life. Therefore, the name Samrithi embodies these noble aspirations and serves as a constant reminder of the importance of equilibrium and balance in one's existence.
